answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded identity: every agent locks a refundable deposit before it can take paid work, so forging a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits. A cheat loses its stake when caught, which turns each forgery into a real financial loss. Reputation then grows slowly, like a juniper on a mesa, while a brand-new agent is held at the wharf and given only tiny low-trust jobs until its record proves itself.
